column1: **turbineSpecsFile:** The path+filename to a turbine specifications file *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADoutputForces:** Flag to include GAD forces in the output: 0=off; 1=on *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADofflineForces:** Flag to compute GAD forces in an offline mode: 0=of; 1=on *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADaxialInduction:** Flag to compute axial induction factor: 0==off (uses prescribed GADaxialIndVal); 1==on *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADaxialIndVal:** Prescribed constant axial induction factor when GADaxialInduction==1 *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADrefSwitch:** Switch to use reference windspeed: 0=off; 1=on *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADrefU:** Prescribed constant reference hub-height windspeed *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADrefSampleWindow:** Sample duration over which to average per-timestep values (filtering out highest frequencies) *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADrefSeriesLength:** Number of sampling windows over which to average again for reference velocity magnitude and direction *C-O if GADSelector > 0*
**GADForcingSwitch:** Switch to use the GADrefU-based or local windspeed in computing GAD forces: 0=local *C-O if GADSelector > 0*; 1=ref
